data.one_liner: Persist Redux state across app restarts with custom storage engines and serializers
data.what_it_does: It creates a Redux middleware that automatically saves your application state to storage on every action, and allows loading the initial state upon startup. It supports custom storage engines and serializers.
use_when: You are using Redux for state management in Flutter or Dart
You need to persist your application state across app restarts
avoid_when: You prefer simpler local key-value storage without a state container
strengths: Supports multiple storage engines (Flutter, Web, File, and custom)
Includes state and raw transformations and custom serializers
weaknesses: Tied directly to the Redux state management ecosystem
Requires manual serialization logic for state classes
